1.mascotDialogue: One edge, but TWO entries in the adjacency matrix. Forget that second one and you've gone and built yourself half a directed graph without even meanin' to.

2.mascotDialogue: Line 2 and line 3 ain't optional extras of each other — they're the same darn edge, and they gotta go in together, as one atomic pair, every single time.

3.mascotDialogue: No arrowheads this time — just a plain line, on account of the connection bein' mutual right down to its bones.

4.mascotDialogue: The visual's showin' a single arrowhead where an undirected graph oughta never have one at all — that mismatch is the bug, made plain impossible to miss.
